attchmntText: Tembo Global Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Tembo Global Industries Records Highest-ever Revenue and Profitability in H1FY27".
voiceSummary: Tembo Global Industries Limited filed a press release regarding its financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue for H1FY27 increased by 8.2% year-on-year to INR 534 crores. EBITDA rose by 40.4% to INR 86 crores, with a margin of 16.1%. Profit after tax grew by 36.2% to INR 57 crores. The company reported an order book exceeding INR 1600 crores and a bidding pipeline of INR 2550 crores. It highlighted progress in renewable energy, with billing started for four solar sites. The company also secured manufacturing licenses for ammunition and small arms. A strategic partnership with Lachaussee SA for an ammunition production line valued at approximately €50 million was announced. Deliveries are scheduled for 2028 and 2029. The filing was submitted to BSE and NSE on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Tembo Global Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Tembo Global Industries Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board approved the Consolidated and Standalone Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The meeting commenced at 04:30 P.M. and concluded at 04:55 P.M. The results are accompanied by Limited Review Reports from Karta and Company, Chartered Accountants. The auditor confirmed that nothing came to their attention to suggest the statements contain material misstatements. The consolidated results include data from six subsidiaries, one joint venture, and one associate company. One subsidiary, Tembo LLC, was not reviewed and its results are excluded. The company filed this information with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited as required under SEBI Listing Regulations.
